market.question: Will the highest temperature in Lagos be 34°C on May 8?

assessment.reasoning: Forecasts for Lagos May 8 indicate ~29°C with patchy rain. May daily highs in Lagos average 30-32°C; 34°C is 2-5°C above expectation and unusual during the rainy season. Very low probability.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether unexpected dry break boosts daytime heating
